Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
FINANCE AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIV
OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the
Balochistan Finance Act, 1965
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2-42/Law/79/IV, dated
20-10-2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
15th October, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Balochistan Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

Amendment of section 5 of W.P. Act I of 1965

ORDINANCE XXXIV OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
FINANCE AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXIV
OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the
Balochistan Finance Act, 1965
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2-42/Law/79/IV, dated
20-10-2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
15th October, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 5 of
W.P. Act I of 1965.---In the Balochistan Finance Act, 1965, in section 5,
for the table of rate of tax or cinemas, the following shall be substituted:-
(i) Class-I Cinema Rs.1,500 per annum
(ii) Class-II Cinema Rs.500 per annum
(iii) Class-III, Cinema Rs.150 per annum
